import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess
L=Path.cwd();W=L/'write_lane.py'
def save(n,s):
 r=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-I','-B',str(W),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0

for x in P:
 raw=Path(f"originals/{x['id']}.jsonl").read_bytes();m=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*',raw);assert m
 tail=raw[m.end():].decode();s,end=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(tail);tok=tail[:end].encode();assert s==x['object']['statement']
 x.update(raw_statement_token=tok.decode(),raw_statement_token_sha256=hashlib.sha256(tok).hexdigest(),decoded_statement_utf8_sha256=hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest(),raw_statement_token_bytes=len(tok),decoded_statement_utf8_bytes=len(s.encode()))
save('corpus-provenance.json',json.dumps(P,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False));print('twenty original token/decoded bindings completed')
root=Path('/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/sources')
for name in ['upstream.json','CONTENTS.md']:
 s=(root/name).read_text(); print('PINNED',name,s[:14000])
p=root/'preprints-tree.json';b=p.read_bytes();print('PINNED full tree bytes/hash',len(b),hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest());tree=json.loads(b)
save('pinned-reference-read.json',json.dumps({'upstream':json.loads((root/'upstream.json').read_text()),'tree_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'tree_complete_parsed':True,'no_source_theorem_used':True},indent=2))
